826-1636-4247-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-4247-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4247-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4247-5631.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-5468.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3317-5058.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
3317-5058.description:
Cast Screams from Within by paying {1}{B}{B}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Historian's Boon and Screams from Within trigger.
Resolve the Historian's Boon trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Screams from Within trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature token
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4770-7056-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Stormscape Familiar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-7056-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1603-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1603-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1603-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2724-3217-3963.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3217-3963.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Meneldor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

851-1558-1671-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-1671-3875-4231.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-1879-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

3887-7117.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and return Lab Rats to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-3921-4552-4832.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

250-779-1479-1669-2374.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-2374.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-1446-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-1446-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1636-4023-5686-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-5686-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-5231-5997-6967.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2921-5010-5708-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

821-883-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

515-1636-1719.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

4559-5491-5686.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
4559-5491-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Blood and a Map token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Blood and Map, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

801-876-4763-6068.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6114.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-5231-6114.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Skyknight Squire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2734-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-2734-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1641-2034-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1283-1641-2034-4192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {2}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2634-4276-5049.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-4276-5049.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1329-1636-4809.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-4809.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shifting Wall from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2882-3682-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3682-4675-4694.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Mox Amber enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4017-4631-4929.description:
Activate Essence Depleter by paying {1}{C}, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
